nodes.description: Owned.owner - privileged address set in the Owned constructor from msg.sender; gates onlyOwner functions.
Owned.newOwner - pending owner used by the two-step transferOwnership/acceptOwnership flow.
ChefShiba.symbol - token symbol, set to CHIBA in the constructor.
ChefShiba.name - token name, set to ChefShiba in the constructor.
ChefShiba.decimals - token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
ChefShiba._totalSupply - total minted supply of 1e33 base units assigned to the deployer at construction.
ChefShiba.balances - mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
ChefShiba.allowed - nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount, written by approve and approveAndCall, consumed by transferFrom.
Constructor of ChefShiba: sets metadata, mints the whole supply to 0xdefE85CCDB092c8F5b53563A6B4e0E1C453C8AFe and emits Transfer.
Owned.transferOwnership(address) - onlyOwner; stages a new owner in newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership() - requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner and clears newOwner.
ChefShiba.transfer(address,uint) - public ERC20 transfer using safeSub/safeAdd on balances for msg.sender.
ChefShiba.approve(address,uint) - writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no zero-first requirement.
ChefShiba.transferFrom(address,address,uint) - spends allowance of msg.sender and moves balances; no allowance/balance return check.
ChefShiba.allowance(address,address) - constant getter for allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
ChefShiba.approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes) - sets allowance then performs an external call into the spender contract.
ChefShiba fallback payable function - unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH.
ChefShiba.transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint) - onlyOwner; calls an arbitrary token contract to sweep tokens to owner.
ChefShiba.totalSupply() - constant; returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked subtraction.
ChefShiba.balanceOf(address) - constant getter for balances[tokenOwner].
Constructor of Owned - assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint,uint) - c = a + b with require(c >= a); overflow check depends on the require.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint,uint) - require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint,uint) - c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint,uint) - require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
Caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances, ownership checks and as the target of external callbacks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed inside approveAndCall after state has been written.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) with a caller-supplied (owner-only) contract address and unchecked return value.
Solidity ^0.4.18 integer arithmetic on uint (addition/subtraction/multiplication) with no compiler-level overflow protection.
_newOwner parameter of transferOwnership(address).
to parameter (recipient) of transfer(address,uint).
tokens parameter (amount) of transfer(address,uint).
spender parameter of approve(address,uint).
tokens parameter (allowance amount) of approve(address,uint).
from parameter (debited account) of transferFrom(address,address,uint).
to parameter (credited account) of transferFrom(address,address,uint).
tokens parameter (amount) of transferFrom(address,address,uint).
tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf(address).
tokenOwner parameter of allowance(address,address).
spender parameter of allowance(address,address).
spender parameter of approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes) - also the contract address that is called back.
tokens parameter of approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes).
data parameter of approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes) - opaque bytes forwarded to the callback.
tokenAddress parameter of transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint) - arbitrary contract to be called.
tokens parameter of transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint).
a parameter (first operand) of safeAdd(uint,uint).
b parameter (second operand) of safeAdd(uint,uint).
a parameter (minuend) of safeSub(uint,uint).
b parameter (subtrahend) of safeSub(uint,uint).

edges.reason: ChefShiba constructor writes the full minted amount into _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the entire supply to balances[0xdefE85...8AFe], concentrating all tokens on one address.
Constructor assigns symbol = CHIBA.
Constructor assigns name = ChefShiba.
Constructor assigns decimals = 18.
Owned constructor initialises the owner state variable.
owner is taken directly from msg.sender, so the deployer/caller controls the privileged role from block zero.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender against owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting the pending owner.
transferOwnership stages the caller-supplied address in newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the handover.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller identity drives the transfer.
Caller-supplied tokens amount flows into the transfer amount.
Caller-supplied to address flows into the transfer destination.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer delegates the debit to safeSub, which reverts on underflow.
transfer delegates the credit to safeAdd.
approve records the allowance under msg.sender as the owner key.
Caller-supplied spender becomes the allowance key.
Caller-supplied tokens value is written verbatim, enabling the classic approve double-spend race.
approve writes directly into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
Caller-supplied from address is debited without any check that it equals msg.sender.
Caller-supplied to address is credited.
Caller-supplied tokens amount is moved.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom relies on safeSub for both balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom relies on safeAdd for the recipient credit.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][...] using the supplied owner key.
allowance reads allowed[...][spender] using the supplied spender key.
allowance returns a value read from the allowed mapping.
balanceOf uses the supplied address as the balances mapping key.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller as owner.
Caller-supplied spender becomes both allowance key and the contract that is called back.
Caller-supplied tokens value flows into the allowance and into the callback arguments.
Caller-supplied bytes data is forwarded untouched into the external callback.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into allowed before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an unbounded external call into spender.receiveApproval, giving the callee control flow with the allowance already written, enabling reentrancy.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by onlyOwner, comparing msg.sender to owner.
Caller-supplied tokenAddress is cast to ERC20Interface and used as the external call target.
Caller-supplied tokens amount is forwarded to the arbitrary token contract.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on a caller-supplied contract and ignores the returned bool, allowing a malicious callee to re-enter or to report false success.
Swept tokens are sent to the owner address, a privileged recipient taken from state.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked uint arithmetic in Solidity ^0.4.18.
First operand of safeAdd.
Second operand of safeAdd.
Minuend operand of safeSub.
Subtrahend operand of safeSub.
safeAdd performs a + b, whose overflow correctness depends solely on require(c >= a).
safeSub performs a - b, guarded only by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs a * b, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter is only used to write the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership, so it collapses into that function.
The to parameter has no independent semantics beyond indexing balances inside transfer.
The tokens parameter is consumed only by the safeSub/safeAdd debit and credit inside transfer.
The spender parameter only serves as the second key of allowed inside approve.
The tokens parameter is written verbatim to allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
The from parameter is only a balances/allowed key inside transferFrom.
The to parameter is only a balances key inside transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is only the moved amount inside transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter is merely the lookup key of the constant getter balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter is only the outer key of the allowed getter allowance.
The spender parameter is only the inner key of the allowed getter allowance.
The spender parameter is both the allowance key and the callback target inside approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is written to allowed and forwarded to the callback in approveAndCall.
The data parameter is forwarded unchanged into the spender callback, so it belongs to the unsafe external call rather than to contract state.
The tokenAddress parameter is cast and used directly as the target of the unchecked external call in transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokens parameter is only forwarded as the amount argument of the sweep call.
The a operand exists only inside the safeAdd arithmetic expression.
The b operand exists only inside the safeAdd arithmetic expression.
The a operand exists only inside the safeSub arithmetic expression.
The b operand exists only inside the safeSub arithmetic expression.
